prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Pearland, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1094; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's fine.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the accident happened?
A: It was at an intersection in Pearland, Texas. I was turning left across traffic.
Q: What were you driving at the time?
A: My sedan. I was going to make a left onto the cross street when another vehicle came through from the opposite direction.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not clearly. I looked, saw a gap, and started my turn. Then I saw headlights getting close, and I tried to stop, but it was too late.
Q: What was the weather and road condition like?
A: It was clear and dry. Daytime, I think mid-afternoon.
Q: Was there a traffic signal at the intersection?
A: Yes, I had a green arrow for the left turn, I believe. Or maybe the light had just turned green for me. I'm not completely sure about that.
Q: Where did the impact occur on your vehicle?
A: The front driver's side area hit the other car's passenger door, I think.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I put my right hand out when the airbag went off and I landed hard on it. The doctor said my wrist is fractured. I have a cast now and I'm still going to physical therapy.
Q: Did you receive medical treatment at the scene?
A: They checked me out there, then I went to the emergency room the same day.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the accident?
A: Only that I've been careful to follow everything the doctors have told me, and I want the claim handled quickly because I can't work with this wrist right now.
Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
A: Okay, thanks.
